name: Infernal Constitution increases max health by 9% and off-hand damage by 29% (#3500)
contract: Infernal Constitution 805256 increases max health by a stored 9% (resolved 10% via the DieSides==1 +1 rule) via native SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT (aura 133) and off-hand weapon damage by a stored 29% (resolved 30%) via native SPELL_AURA_MOD_OFFHAND_DAMAGE_PCT (aura 122). The harness has no per-hand outgoing-damage metric, so the off-hand effect is checked at the aura's own resolved value (the same handler is exercised end to end for #1967 Burning Legionnaire in this batch).
